32003.name: Clark County
32003.note: Las Vegas valley: LVMPD's 911 routing layer (effective 2024-09-01) assigns areas to AMR, Community Ambulance and MedicWest. The layer does not cover Henderson, North Las Vegas, Boulder City, Mesquite, Moapa Valley or Mount Charleston, so the layer alone does not settle this county. Henderson Fire and Boulder City Fire run their own ambulances and Mesquite Fire & Rescue runs a city ambulance (city websites, not area records). North Las Vegas: MedicWest says it covers the city (amr.net); no city record found. Moapa Valley transport role could not be verified.
a: City of Las Vegas Fire & Rescue

32005.name: Douglas County
32005.note: East Fork Fire serves Douglas County outside the Tahoe Basin; Tahoe Douglas Fire serves Zephyr Cove and Stateline. Whether Tahoe Douglas transports could not be verified.
